name: Qualify leads by tech stack with Apify from Google Sheets to Slack

parameters.content:
## Qualify leads by tech stack with Apify from Google Sheets to Slack

### Who's it for
Agencies, app developers and SaaS sales teams who sell to users of one platform: Shopify app makers, HubSpot partners, WordPress agencies and so on.

### How it works
1. Reads the domains in your Google Sheet that have not been scanned yet.
2. Sends them in one batch to the [Tech Stack Detector](https://apify.com/moha-tah/tech-stack-detector) Actor. It checks 7,600+ technologies in HTML, headers, scripts and cookies, plus **DNS**, which reveals the email provider and SaaS verifications that page-only tools miss.
3. Writes the full stack and a `match` column for the technologies you target back to the sheet.
4. Posts the matching domains to Slack.

### How to set up
1. Create a sheet with a `domain` column.
2. In **Settings**, list your target technologies (comma-separated, e.g. `Shopify, Klaviyo`) and paste the sheet URL and tab name.
3. Add your Apify credential to **Scan tech stack (Apify)**, then connect Google Sheets and Slack.
4. Choose the Slack channel and click **Test workflow**.

### Requirements
- An [Apify account](https://console.apify.com/sign-up) (the free plan works) and its API token, saved in n8n as a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
- Google Sheets and Slack credentials.
- Cost: $0.004 per analyzed domain, unreachable sites are free.

### How to customize
Replace Slack with email or your CRM, or trigger the workflow when a new row is added.

### 1. Settings
List the technologies you target and paste your sheet URL and tab name.

### 2. Scan with Apify
One call for all new domains. Add your Apify Header Auth credential here.

### 3. Save and alert
The full stack goes back to the sheet; matching domains are posted to Slack.
